messages:
dena_csm: FYI — Evergreen Health flagged a procurement freeze, asking if we can do a 6-month bridge at existing pricing while they finish approvals. They need procurement + legal ok. I'll paste exact ask below.

maria_cs: Can you paste their exact ask? Also what's current ARR and seats?

den a_csm: Quote from procurement: 'need a short-term bridge contract (6mo) at current rate, PO only. CFO wants evidence of data residency and KMS support.' Account: 150 seats, current ARR $210k/yr, contract ends 2025-04-30.

aj_sales: We can propose a 6mo bridge at current unit pricing, but recommend a 15% deposit to protect revenue. Alternative: 6mo at same price if signed PO + letter of intent to renew 12mo at term end. Which approach do we want to present?

leo_finance: PO only is fine. Need vendor code and billing entity on the PO. Deposit accepted, GL code to use: 4002. @billing-bot can you generate a proforma for the 6mo ask?

billing-bot: Generated proforma (proforma-id: PF-2025-0009). Invoice snippet:
```
Invoice: PRO-FORMA-2025-0009
Amount: $105,000 (6mo)
Deposit: $15,750 (15%)
Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Payment terms: Net 30 upon PO receipt
```

sarah_legal: We'll need a short SOW addendum + MSA amendment for a 6mo stopgap. Also confirm KMS requirement: if they require customer-managed keys (CMK) we need Private deployment addendum and ops lead signoff. @dena_csm can you confirm whether CMK is a hard requirement or a preference?

neil_enablement: If they sign the bridge, enablement can do a light onboarding (1 week) + a 90-day enablement plan focused on provisioning and cost controls. Availability wk of 2025-05-05 for kickoff. Do we want a tailored enablement deck for 150 seats?

maria_cs: I'll run the procurement/exec call Thurs 10am PT. Proposed agenda: 1) pricing option (deposit vs LOI), 2) PO timing & vendor code, 3) legal/KMS ask, 4) enablement timeline and product feedback slot. @aj_sales please join.

aj_sales: I'll join and prep an exec summary + recommended concession levels. If PO arrives by Tue 2025-04-29 we can lock current pricing; otherwise we need to run price recalc. I'll draft two bullets to present.

docusign-bot: Draft addendum prepared and sent to internal reviewers (workflow id: wf-9921). Waiting on legal sig to route to customer.

den a_csm: Customer also asked for 'evidence of EU data residency' and an export of our EU region SLA — I'll attach the doc and ping them after the call. They also requested a short product feedback session about streaming latency on long chats.

neil_enablement: I'll add a 30-min product feedback slot in the enablement plan specifically for Ops/Product to capture latency repro steps and logs. @maria_cs please confirm customer attendees so we can prep.

maria_cs: Confirmed — I'll get attendee list on the call and post the calendar invite after the meeting. :thumbsup:
